record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

)
exit

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
systemctl stop firewalld
systemctl disable firewalld
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%cusaagent_folder%_win
:: set remote_folder=\10.170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

function start_mxgate()
{
  ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9 > /dev/null 2>&1
  mxgate stop --force > /dev/null 2>&1
  mxgate start --config $PAS_ROOT/pas/tool/mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf
}

source /etc/profile
source /usr/local/matrixdb/greenplum_path.sh

typeset -i pid_cnt
typeset -i mxgate_pid
typeset -i sys_pid

pid_cnt=$(ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | wc -l)

if [ $pid_cnt -gt 1 ];then
  start_mxgate
elif [ $pid_cnt -eq 1 ];then
  mxgate status > ~/mxgate_status.tmp 2>&1
  mxgate_pid=$(cat ~/mxgate_status.tmp | grep "PID" | grep "alive" | awk '{print $2}')
  sys_pid=$(ps -ef | grep mxgate | grep mxgate_pasdb_pmhis.conf | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}')
  if [ $mxgate_pid -ne $sys_pid ]; then
    start_mxgate
  fi
else
  start_mxgate
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

cd /d %~dp0
cd ..
set WEB_HOME=%cd%

set MYSQL_HOME=%WEB_HOME%/thirdparty/mysql
cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin

if not exist my.ini (
    echo create msql initialize file...
    (
    echo [mysql]
    echo default-character-set=utf8mb4
    echo [mysqld]
    echo port = 3306
    echo basedir= %MYSQL_HOME%/
    echo datadir= %MYSQL_HOME%/data
    echo max_connections=50
    echo character-set-server=utf8
    echo default-storage-engine=INNODB
    echo default_authentication_plugin=mysql_native_password
    ) > my.ini
    echo install mysql...
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/
    mkdir data
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin
    mysqld --initialize-insecure --user=root
    mysqld --install

    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql

    echo set pwd for root...
    set username=root
    set pwd=vislecaina
    mysql -uroot -e "alter user '%username%'@'localhost' identified by '%pwd%';"

    echo load database data...
    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/cablehealthdb.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_operationinfo_sql.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_role_operation_sql.sql"

) else (
    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql
)

cd %WEB_HOME% in
pause

#!/bin/bash
export MINIO_ACCESS_USER=admin 
export MINIO_SECRT_KEY=password 
APPNAME=Minio
getpid(){
	pid=`ps -ef | grep minio | grep server| awk '{print $2}'`;
	if [ -n "$pid" ];
	then 
		return 1
	else
		return 0
	fi
}

getpid
#when pid is not empty. $?=1
if [ $? -eq 1 ]
then
   	echo "${APPNAME} is already running. pid:${pid}."
	echo "will killing thread(program_name:${APPNAME} pid:${pid})"
	kill -9 ${pid}
	echo "starting your program ${APPNAME}.waiting......"
	#cd /usr/local/src/iot-device-manage-cloud
        /opt/minio/minio server --address 0.0.0.0:9000 --console-address 0.0.0.0:9001 --config-dir /opt/minio/config  http://10.171.25.151/data1 http://10.171.25.152/data2  http://10.171.25.153/data3 > /opt/minio/logs/minio.log 	
else
	echo "starting your program.waiting......"
	#cd /usr/local/src/iot-device-manage-cloud
        /opt/minio/minio server --address 0.0.0.0:9000 --console-address 0.0.0.0:9001 --config-dir /opt/minio/config http://10.171.25.151/data1 http://10.171.25.152/data2  http://10.171.25.153/data3 > /opt/minio/logs/minio.log 	
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.127.6.15:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

     1.了解学习了通过环回挂表测试，并结合省干网管查看业务单盘OTU4S线路误码率性能值模块，快速定位单盘故障并及时更换单盘恢复业务。
     2.出现光缆衰耗时，了解如何结合EOSCAD光监控盘确认光缆衰耗，并根据光功率计和信号流图一段段测试光功率，快速定位故障发生模块，恢复相关业务。
     3.去新乡参与OMSP改造工程，了解了OMSP 1+1保护改造的相关原理，能够根据连纤图去机房现场独立完成跳纤及调试工作，增加了现场工作经验。
     4.了解了单盘及网管升级打补丁的相关步骤流程，并对其中的重要步骤和注意事项进行重点学习理解，例如主备先升主、倒换后升备、交叉盘去激活再升级、注意软件包后缀名等。
     5.协助导师参与河南联通OTN试验网的开通调测，了解并学习了OTN设备上管及设备连纤的基本流程和步骤。
   该季度主要是帮助参与OTN网络的相关改造和告警处理、设备开通调测，后续将会对单盘设备升级、网管打补丁、日常巡检维护进行深入的学习了解，并对OTN网络的相关具体告警和各地市的本地网拓扑存在的隐患告警进行深入的学习，当多多努力，更加熟悉本地网和省干的OTN网络结构。

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation

# not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain
# a copy of the License at

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
done
sleep 3
java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port

#!/bin/bash

# filter out unm2000 so library
# export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH//\/opt\/unm2000\/[^:]*:/}

current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
echo current_path=$current_path
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH


CA="${current_path}/ca"
TLS="${current_path}/tls"

rm -rf "${TLS}"
mkdir -p "${TLS}"

#NR==2 use the second line
IP=`awk -F '=' 'NR==2{print $2}' ${current_path}/conf/product.conf`
echo ip=$IP

cat >  "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" << EOF
[ req ]
prompt                  = no
utf8                    = yes
string_mask             = utf8only

attributes              = req_attributes
req_extensions          = v3_req 
distinguished_name      = req_distinguished_name


[ req_distinguished_name ]
C                       = CN
ST                      = Hubei
L                       = Wuhan
O                       = Fiberhome
OU                      = FiberhomeWeb
CN                      = nmtool

[ req_attributes ]
challengePassword       = A challenge password

[ v3_req ]
basicConstraints        = CA:FALSE
keyUsage                = digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage        = serverAuth
subjectAltName          = @alt_names

[ alt_names ]
IP = $IP
EOF


openssl genpkey \n        -algorithm RSA \n        -out "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048

openssl req -new \n        -key "${TLS}/server.key" \n        -out "${TLS}/server.csr" \n        -config "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n        -extensions v3_req

# openssl x509 \n#         -req \n#         -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n#         -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n#         -extensions v3_req \n#         -CA "${CA}/ca.crt" \n#         -CAkey "${CA}/ca.key" \n#         -CAcreateserial \n#         -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n#         -days 3650 \n#         -sha256

openssl ca -batch \n    -config "${CA}/openssl.cnf" \n    -keyfile "${CA}/ca.key" \n    -cert "${CA}/ca.crt" \n    -in "${TLS}/server.csr" \n    -out "${TLS}/server.crt" \n    -extfile "${TLS}/openssl.cnf" \n    -extensions v3_req \n    -create_serial \n    -startdate 20180101020000Z \n    -days 3650 

> ${CA}/index.txt

cp ${TLS}/server.key ${current_path}/conf/server_nopwd.key
cp ${TLS}/server.crt ${current_path}/conf/server.crt

# openssl x509 -in "${TLS}/server.crt"  -noout -text

#!/bin/bash -x

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc
